Traitement Indice acoustique
Import sur un DF différent de tout les indices et audio de 10 minutes
```{r}
chemin <- "~/Césure/Tahiti/Data_IA_Tahiti_10m_Pro"
fichiers_xlsx <- list.files(
  chemin,
  pattern = "\\.xlsx$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)
IA_10m_0.3_8Khz <- lapply(fichiers_xlsx, read_excel)
IA_10m_0.3_8Khz  <- bind_rows(lapply(fichiers_xlsx, read_excel))
```

Pour DF_IA10 : Simplification des Dataset pour avoir des indices acoustiques par fichier, 1 par ligne, on nettoie l'indice ACI pour n'avoir que la valeur principale pour un fichier (pas par fréquence de 1000 Hz). on supprimer les colonnes créé vide avec les NA
```{r}
IA_10m_0.3_8Khz <- IA_10m_0.3_8Khz %>%
  dplyr::select(where(~ !all(is.na(.)))) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Enr = projet)

IA_10m <- IA_10m_0.3_8Khz %>%
  group_by(Enr, fichier) %>%
  summarise(
    ACI = first(ACI_val),
    ADI = first(ADI_val.adi_left),
    AEI  = first(AEI_val.aei_left),
    BIO  = first(BIO_val.left_area),
    H = first(H_val),
    M = first(M_val),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
#On rajoute les variables principales pour chaque ligne  d'indice pour les fichiers analysés
DF_IA10 <- IA_10m %>%
  left_join(
    Data_Globale_Tahiti,
    by = "Enr"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Fichier,
         -EAA)
```

Centré_réduire les variables de communauté pour modélisation
```{r}
DF_IA10_sc <- DF_IA10 %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(S, S_Exo),
      ~ as.numeric(scale(.)),
      .names = "{.col}_sc"
    )
  )
```

x6 modèle pour chaque variable de communautés avec les indices acoustiques
```{r}
mod_ADI_S <- lmer(
  ADI ~ S_sc+(1 | Commune/Enr),
  data = DF_IA10_sc,
  REML = FALSE
)
mod_ACI_S <- lmer(
  ACI ~ S_sc+(1 | Commune/Enr),
  data = DF_IA10_sc,
  REML = FALSE
)
mod_AEI_S<- lmer(
  AEI ~ S_sc+(1 | Commune/Enr),
  data = DF_IA10_sc,
  REML = FALSE
)
mod_BIO_S <- lmer(
  BIO ~ S_sc+(1 | Commune/Enr),
  data = DF_IA10_sc,
  REML = FALSE
)
mod_H_S <- lmer(
  H ~ S_sc+(1 | Commune/Enr),
  data = DF_IA10_sc,
  REML = FALSE
)
mod_M_S <- lmer(
  M ~ S_sc+(1 | Commune/Enr),
  data = DF_IA10_sc,
  REML = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
##Revenir à l’échelle réelle (%)
mean_S <- mean(DF_IA10_sc$`S`, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_S   <- sd(DF_IA10_sc$`S`, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_SExo <- mean(DF_IA10_sc$`S_Exo`, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_SExo   <- sd(DF_IA10_sc$`S_Exo`, na.rm = TRUE)
```
```{r}
theme_soundscape <- function() {
  
  theme_minimal() +
    
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F8FAFC", colour = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "#F8FAFC", colour = NA),

    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#CBD5E1", linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

    axis.text  = element_text(color = "#64748B", size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "#64748B", size = 12, face = "bold"),

    axis.line = element_line(color = "#64748B", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "#64748B"),

    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "#F8FAFC"),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "#64748B"),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "#64748B", face = "bold")
  )
}
```

```{r}
pred_ADI_S <- ggpredict(
  mod_ADI_S,
  terms = "S_sc [all]"
)

##Graphique
ggplot(pred_ADI_S, aes(x = x* sd_S+mean_S, y = predicted)) +
  
  geom_line(size = 1.2, colour = "#334155") +
  
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
    alpha = 0.35,
    fill = "#CCA9DD"
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Total richness",
    y = "Predicted ADI (±95% CI)"
  ) +
  
  theme_soundscape()

pred_ADI_SExo <- ggpredict(
  mod_ADI_SExo,
  terms = "S_Exo_sc [all]"
)

##Graphique
ggplot(pred_ADI_SExo, aes(x = x* sd_SExo+mean_SExo, y = predicted)) +
  
  geom_line(size = 1.2, colour = "#334155") +
  
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
    alpha = 0.35,
    fill = "#CCA9DD"
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Exotic Richness",
    y = "Predicted ADI (±95% CI)"
  ) +
  
  theme_soundscape()
```
